title: OpenAI and Hugging Face address security incident during model evaluation
summary: OpenAI and Hugging Face publicly disclosed a security incident that occurred during the model evaluation process, highlighting the importance of security protocols when testing and evaluating AI models from external sources.
problem_solved: Addresses the disclosure of a security vulnerability or incident that was discovered during the process of evaluating AI models.
why_valuable: Demonstrates transparency in AI security practices and helps the community understand risks associated with external model evaluation processes.
